title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Blackberry Raspberry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blackberry Raspberry combines rich, dark Blackberry flavour with a bright Raspberry edge for a balanced sweet-and-tart blend. It’s a smooth, layered berry vape with a clean finish and subtle freshness. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod includes a prefilled 2ml pod attached to a 10ml refill reservoir, giving 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No coil changes or refilling required—simply attach to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. A dual mesh coil ensures consistent performance and clear flavour for up to 6000 puffs (approx.). Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
